```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(plotly)
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
LABEL_COLORS <- c(
  "Tumor"    = "#FB8072",
  "Stroma"   = "#8DD3C7",
  "Immune"   = "#80B1D3",
  "Necrosis" = "#B3DE69",
  "Fat"      = "#FDB462",
  "Mixed"    = "#FFFFB3",
  "Other"    = "#BEBADA"
)

project_dir <- "/Users/mingruili/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-Emory/ST/ST"
ann_dir     <- file.path(project_dir, "data", "cap", "spot_annotations")

ann_files       <- list.files(ann_dir, pattern = "\\.RDS$", full.names = TRUE)
ann_list        <- lapply(ann_files, readRDS)
names_from_file <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(ann_files))

ann_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(ann_list, .id = "file_idx")
ann_all$sample_id <- rep(names_from_file, times = sapply(ann_list, nrow))

ann_all <- ann_all %>%
  tidyr::separate(spot_id, into = c("spot_row", "spot_col"),
                  sep = "x", remove = FALSE, convert = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::rename(x = spot_col, y = spot_row)

ann_all <- ann_all %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    label_simple = dplyr::case_when(
      hard_label == "Tumor"                   ~ "Tumor",
      hard_label == "Stroma"                  ~ "Stroma",
      hard_label %in% c("Lymphocytes", "TLS") ~ "Immune",
      hard_label == "Necrosis"                ~ "Necrosis",
      hard_label == "Fat tissue"              ~ "Fat",
      hard_label == "Mixed"                   ~ "Mixed",
      TRUE                                    ~ "Other"
    )
  )

slides <- sort(unique(ann_all$sample_id))

composition_raw <- ann_all %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_id, label_simple) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_spots = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_id) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    total_spots = sum(n_spots),
    pct         = round(100 * n_spots / total_spots, 1)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

tumor_order <- composition_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(label_simple == "Tumor") %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, tumor_pct = pct)

composition <- composition_raw %>%
  dplyr::left_join(tumor_order, by = "sample_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(tumor_pct = tidyr::replace_na(tumor_pct, 0))
```

```{r dashboard, echo=FALSE}
# SERVER
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
server <- function(input, output, session) {

  slide_data <- reactive({
    ann_all %>%
      dplyr::filter(sample_id    == input$selected_slide,
                    label_simple %in% input$selected_labels)
  })

  # ── Sidebar KPI boxes (Single Sample) ───────────────────────────────────
  output$kpi_boxes <- renderUI({
    df         <- ann_all %>% dplyr::filter(sample_id == input$selected_slide)
    n_spots    <- nrow(df)
    tumor_pct  <- round(100 * mean(df$label_simple == "Tumor",  na.rm = TRUE), 1)
    stroma_pct <- round(100 * mean(df$label_simple == "Stroma", na.rm = TRUE), 1)
    avg_tumor  <- round(mean(df$Tumor, na.rm = TRUE), 2)

    tagList(
      div(class = "kpi-box",
          div(formatC(n_spots, format = "d", big.mark = ","), class = "kpi-val"),
          div("Total Spots",    class = "kpi-lbl")),
      div(class = "kpi-box",
          div(paste0(tumor_pct,  "%"), class = "kpi-val"),
          div("Tumor Spots",     class = "kpi-lbl")),
      div(class = "kpi-box",
          div(paste0(stroma_pct, "%"), class = "kpi-val"),
          div("Stroma Spots",    class = "kpi-lbl")),
      div(class = "kpi-box",
          div(avg_tumor,         class = "kpi-val"),
          div("Avg Tumor Fraction", class = "kpi-lbl"))
    )
  })

  # ── Cohort KPI strip (All Samples page) ─────────────────────────────────
  output$cohort_kpis <- renderUI({
    n_slides       <- length(unique(ann_all$sample_id))
    n_spots_total  <- nrow(ann_all)
    avg_tumor_pct  <- round(mean(ann_all$label_simple == "Tumor",  na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1)
    avg_stroma_pct <- round(mean(ann_all$label_simple == "Stroma", na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1)
    avg_mixed_pct  <- round(mean(ann_all$label_simple == "Mixed",  na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1)

    tumor_by_slide <- ann_all %>%
      dplyr::group_by(sample_id) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(tp = round(100 * mean(label_simple == "Tumor", na.rm = TRUE), 1),
                       .groups = "drop")
    top_slide <- tumor_by_slide %>% dplyr::slice_max(tp, n = 1)

    kpi_card <- function(val, lbl, sub = NULL, accent = "") {
      column(
        width = 2,
        div(
          class = paste("cohort-kpi-card", accent),
          div(val, class = "ck-val"),
          div(lbl, class = "ck-lbl"),
          if (!is.null(sub)) div(sub, class = "ck-sub")
        )
      )
    }

    fluidRow(
      class = "cohort-kpi-row",
      kpi_card(n_slides,
               "Total Slides",       "in cohort",        "accent-blue"),
      kpi_card(formatC(n_spots_total, format = "d", big.mark = ","),
               "Total Spots",        "across all slides", "accent-gray"),
      kpi_card(paste0(avg_tumor_pct,  "%"),
               "Avg Tumor",          "across cohort",    "accent-red"),
      kpi_card(paste0(avg_stroma_pct, "%"),
               "Avg Stroma",         "across cohort",    "accent-teal"),
      kpi_card(paste0(avg_mixed_pct,  "%"),
               "Avg Mixed",          "across cohort",    "accent-gold"),
      kpi_card(paste0(top_slide$tp[1], "%"),
               "Highest Tumor Slide", top_slide$sample_id[1], "accent-red")
    )
  })

  # ── Widget 1: Composition Stacked Bar (All Samples) ──────────────────────
  output$plot_composition <- renderPlotly({
    label_order <- c("Tumor","Stroma","Immune","Necrosis","Fat","Mixed","Other")
    slide_order <- composition %>%
      dplyr::filter(label_simple == "Tumor") %>%
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(pct)) %>%
      dplyr::pull(sample_id)
    missing     <- setdiff(unique(composition$sample_id), slide_order)
    slide_order <- c(slide_order, missing)

    comp_ord <- composition %>%
      dplyr::mutate(sample_id = factor(sample_id, levels = slide_order))

    fig <- plot_ly()
    for (lbl in label_order) {
      df_l <- comp_ord %>% dplyr::filter(label_simple == lbl)
      if (nrow(df_l) == 0) next
      fig <- fig %>% add_trace(
        x = df_l$sample_id, y = df_l$pct,
        type = "bar", name = lbl,
        marker = list(color = LABEL_COLORS[lbl],
                      line  = list(color = "white", width = 0.5)),
        text = paste0(
          "<b>Slide:</b> ",       df_l$sample_id, "<br>",
          "<b>Tissue type:</b> ", lbl,            "<br>",
          "<b>Percentage:</b> ",  df_l$pct, "%",  "<br>",
          "<b>Spot count:</b> ",  df_l$n_spots
        ),
        hoverinfo = "text"
      )
    }
    fig %>% layout(
      barmode = "stack",
      xaxis   = list(title = "Slide ID", tickangle = -35,
                     tickfont = list(size = 10), showgrid = FALSE),
      yaxis   = list(title = "Percentage of Spots (%)", ticksuffix = "%",
                     range = c(0, 100), showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = "#eeeeee"),
      legend  = list(title = list(text = "<b>Tissue Type</b>"),
                     font  = list(size = 12), traceorder = "normal"),
      plot_bgcolor  = "white", paper_bgcolor = "white",
      margin = list(t = 30, b = 110, l = 60, r = 20)
    ) %>% config(displayModeBar = TRUE, displaylogo = FALSE,
                 modeBarButtonsToRemove = list("lasso2d", "select2d"))
  })

  # ── Widget 2a: Spatial Tissue Map (Single Sample) ────────────────────────
  output$plot_spatial <- renderPlotly({
    df <- slide_data()
    sl <- input$selected_slide
    if (nrow(df) == 0)
      return(plot_ly() %>% layout(title = "No data for selected filters"))

    fig <- plot_ly()
    for (lbl in names(LABEL_COLORS)) {
      df_l <- df %>% dplyr::filter(label_simple == lbl)
      if (nrow(df_l) == 0) next
      fig <- fig %>% add_trace(
        x = df_l$x, y = -df_l$y,
        type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
        name = lbl, legendgroup = lbl,
        marker = list(color   = LABEL_COLORS[lbl], size = 5,
                      opacity = 0.85, line = list(width = 0)),
        text = paste0(
          "<b>Spot:</b> ",            df_l$spot_id,              "<br>",
          "<b>Label:</b> ",           lbl,                       "<br>",
          "<b>Tumor fraction:</b> ",  round(df_l$Tumor,    2),   "<br>",
          "<b>Stroma fraction:</b> ", round(df_l$Stroma,   2),   "<br>",
          "<b>Dominance score:</b> ", round(df_l$max_prop, 2)
        ),
        hoverinfo = "text"
      )
    }
    fig %>% layout(
      title  = list(text = paste0("<b>Tissue Map — ", sl, "</b>"),
                    font = list(size = 14)),
      xaxis  = list(title = "Spot Column Position (grid index)",
                    showgrid = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE),
      yaxis  = list(title = "Spot Row Position (grid index)",
                    showgrid = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE, scaleanchor = "x"),
      legend = list(title = list(text = "<b>Tissue Type</b>"),
                    font  = list(size = 12), itemsizing = "constant"),
      plot_bgcolor  = "white", paper_bgcolor = "white",
      margin = list(t = 50, b = 40, l = 60, r = 20)
    ) %>% config(displayModeBar = TRUE, displaylogo = FALSE,
                 modeBarButtonsToRemove = list("lasso2d", "select2d"))
  })

  # ── Widget 2b: Tumor Fraction Heatmap (Single Sample) ───────────────────
  output$plot_heatmap <- renderPlotly({
    df <- ann_all %>%
      dplyr::filter(sample_id == input$selected_slide, !is.na(Tumor))
    sl <- input$selected_slide
    if (nrow(df) == 0)
      return(plot_ly() %>% layout(title = "No data for selected slide"))

    plot_ly(
      x = df$x, y = -df$y,
      type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
      marker = list(
        color      = df$Tumor,
        colorscale = list(list(0,   "#f0f0f0"), list(0.3, "#fca082"),
                          list(0.6, "#fb6a4a"), list(1,   "#99000d")),
        cmin = 0, cmax = 1, size = 5, opacity = 0.9,
        showscale = TRUE,
        colorbar  = list(title = list(text = "Tumor<br>Fraction",
                                      font = list(size = 12)),
                         tickformat = ".1f", len = 0.6, thickness = 15)
      ),
      text = paste0(
        "<b>Spot:</b> ",            df$spot_id,          "<br>",
        "<b>Tumor fraction:</b> ",  round(df$Tumor,  3), "<br>",
        "<b>Stroma fraction:</b> ", round(df$Stroma, 3), "<br>",
        "<b>Hard label:</b> ",      df$hard_label
      ),
      hoverinfo = "text", showlegend = FALSE
    ) %>% layout(
      title = list(text = paste0("<b>Tumor Fraction Heatmap — ", sl, "</b>"),
                   font = list(size = 14)),
      xaxis = list(title = "Spot Column Position (grid index)",
                   showgrid = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE),
      yaxis = list(title = "Spot Row Position (grid index)",
                   showgrid = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE, scaleanchor = "x"),
      plot_bgcolor  = "white", paper_bgcolor = "white",
      margin = list(t = 50, b = 40, l = 60, r = 20)
    ) %>% config(displayModeBar = TRUE, displaylogo = FALSE,
                 modeBarButtonsToRemove = list("lasso2d", "select2d"))
  })

  # ── Dynamic takeaway: Spatial Tissue Map ────────────────────────────────
  output$takeaway_spatial <- renderUI({
    df  <- ann_all %>% dplyr::filter(sample_id == input$selected_slide)
    sl  <- input$selected_slide
    n_spots      <- nrow(df)
    top_label    <- df %>% dplyr::count(label_simple, sort = TRUE) %>% dplyr::slice(1)
    second_label <- df %>% dplyr::count(label_simple, sort = TRUE) %>% dplyr::slice(2)
    top_pct      <- round(100 * top_label$n    / n_spots, 1)
    second_pct   <- round(100 * second_label$n / n_spots, 1)
    tumor_df     <- df %>% dplyr::filter(label_simple == "Tumor")
    n_tumor      <- nrow(tumor_df)
    tumor_pct    <- round(100 * n_tumor / n_spots, 1)
    n_types      <- dplyr::n_distinct(df$label_simple)

    div(class = "takeaway-box",
      tags$b("Key Takeaway — ", sl, ": "),
      paste0(
        "This slide contains ", formatC(n_spots, format = "d", big.mark = ","),
        " annotated spots across ", n_types, " tissue types. ",
        top_label$label_simple, " is the dominant tissue, covering ",
        top_pct, "% of spots",
        if (nrow(second_label) > 0)
          paste0(", followed by ", second_label$label_simple, " at ", second_pct, "%")
        else "", ". ",
        if (n_tumor > 0)
          paste0(
            "Tumor spots (", tumor_pct, "% of this slide) ",
            "form spatially concentrated clusters visible as contiguous red regions — ",
            "use the sidebar checkboxes to isolate any tissue type and explore its spatial pattern."
          )
        else
          paste0(
            "No Tumor-labeled spots are present on this slide. ",
            "Use the sidebar checkboxes to explore the spatial distribution of each type."
          )
      )
    )
  })

  # ── Dynamic takeaway: Tumor Fraction Heatmap ─────────────────────────────
  output$takeaway_heatmap <- renderUI({
    df <- ann_all %>%
      dplyr::filter(sample_id == input$selected_slide, !is.na(Tumor))
    sl           <- input$selected_slide
    avg_tumor    <- round(mean(df$Tumor, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
    max_tumor    <- round(max(df$Tumor,  na.rm = TRUE), 2)
    n_boundary   <- sum(df$Tumor >= 0.3 & df$Tumor <= 0.7, na.rm = TRUE)
    pct_boundary <- round(100 * n_boundary / nrow(df), 1)
    high_spots   <- sum(df$Tumor >= 0.6, na.rm = TRUE)
    pct_high     <- round(100 * high_spots / nrow(df), 1)

    div(class = "takeaway-box",
      tags$b("Key Takeaway — ", sl, ": "),
      paste0(
        "The average Tumor fraction across this slide is ",
        avg_tumor, " (max: ", max_tumor, "). ",
        pct_boundary, "% of spots fall in the intermediate range (0.3–0.7), ",
        "representing boundary zones where tumor and non-tumor tissue mix — ",
        "these are the spots most sensitive to the dominance threshold choice. ",
        pct_high, "% of spots have a Tumor fraction ≥ 0.6, ",
        "corresponding to the dark-red regions visible in the heatmap above."
      )
    )
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server, options = list(height = 850))
```
